searchDocs.title: Net​
searchDocs.content: </> Struktura.Net: any Low-level networking implementation. Most projects should not interact with this directly. Prefer: Struktura.GetService (client) / Struktura.GetService (server) service Client methods service Client signals created via Struktura.CreateSignal

searchDocs.title: Configure​
searchDocs.content: </> Struktura.Configure(options: Settings?) → () Configure Struktura runtime options (call before Struktura.Start). Currently supported: ServicePromises (default true): when true, client service method calls return a Promise-like object. When false, client service method calls synchronously :await() and return the result (this yields).

searchDocs.title: CreateLifecycle​
searchDocs.content: </> Struktura.CreateLifecycle( name: string, signal: EventSignal ) → PromiseLike-- Rejects if the lifecycle name already exists. Create and (optionally) bind a custom lifecycle event. Modules can receive this lifecycle by defining On<LifecycleName>(...). If Struktura has already started (or is starting), the lifecycle is bound immediately.

searchDocs.title: CreateSignal​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the server. Server </> Struktura.CreateSignal() → () Create a signal marker for use inside a service's Client table. At startup, Struktura converts these markers into server signal objects with: :Fire(target, ...) :FireAll(...) :FireList(list, ...) :FireExcept(exceptName, ...) On the client, the same field appears as a signal with :Connect(callback) on the proxy returned by Struktura.GetService.

searchDocs.title: OnStart​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> Struktura.OnStart() → () Returns a Promise that resolves once Struktura has finished starting.

searchDocs.title: Initialize​
searchDocs.content: </> Struktura.Initialize( container: Folder , deep: boolean? ) → PromiseLike-- Resolves with a timing string. Load/register modules from a container folder. If deep is truthy, Struktura scans all descendants; otherwise only direct children. Modules returning a table are registered as either: Controller (client): table has Type == "Controller" Service (server): everything else

searchDocs.title: GetController​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client </> Struktura.GetController(name: string) → T? Get a previously-initialized controller by name. Controllers are registered during Struktura.Initialize. Names come from the table's Name field, or fall back to the ModuleScript name.

searchDocs.title: GetService​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client This item only works when running on the server. Server This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> Struktura.GetService(name: string) → T Get a service by name. Server: returns the raw service table loaded during Struktura.Initialize. Client: returns a cached proxy built from server metadata. Client proxy behavior: Signals become objects with :Connect(callback). Any method call Service:MethodName(...) performs a request to the server. Use Struktura.Configure to control whether client method calls return a Promise (ServicePromises = true) or yield and return directly (ServicePromises = false).

searchDocs.title: Start​
searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client This item only works when running on the server. Server This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> Struktura.Start() → () Start Struktura. What this does: Ensures networking is started. Binds built-in and custom lifecycles. Runs Init on every loaded module (services on server / controllers on client). Server only: surfaces service Client APIs (signals + RPC handlers). Marks Struktura as started, then runs Start for each module. On the client, Struktura waits for the server to set the ServerReady attribute before continuing.
